laws.rule: Recreational cannabis is illegal in Texas; only low-THC cannabis under the Compassionate Use Program is allowed, for registered patients. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.

sources.title: Cannabis and the law: recreational use
sources.supports: recreational use illegal (read via a search-index snapshot)

items.text: Possessing a usable quantity of marihuana is an offence: two ounces or less is a Class B misdemeanour, more than two and up to four ounces a Class A misdemeanour (Health and Safety Code s. 481.121).
Only low-THC cannabis is available, on a Texas prescription from a licensed dispensing organisation, and smoking it is prohibited (Occupations Code s. 169.001).
